defmodule Catering.Forms do
  @moduledoc """
  Facade that the LiveView layer uses to build, mutate, inspect and submit the
  nested catering order form.
  """

  alias Catering.Orders.Order

  @root_name "order"

  @spec new_order_form() :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def new_order_form do
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_create(Order, :place, name: @root_name)
  end

  @spec edit_order_form(String.t() | Ash.UUID.t()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def edit_order_form(order_id) when is_binary(order_id) do
    order =
      Ash.get!(Order, order_id, load: [
        :customer,
        [line_items: :modifiers]
      ])

    AshPhoenix.Form.for_update(order, :revise, name: @root_name, forms: [
      line_items: [
        forms: [:modifiers],
        opts: [sort: :position]
      ],
      :customer,
      :delivery_windows,
      :fulfillment
    ])
  end

  @spec to_phoenix_form(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: Phoenix.HTML.Form.t()
  def to_phoenix_form(form), do: AshPhoenix.Form.to_phoenix_form(form)

  @spec change(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), map(), keyword()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def change(form, params, opts \\ []), do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)

  @spec add_nested(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), keyword()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_nested(form, path, opts)
  end

  @spec remove_nested(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def remove_nested(form, path), do: AshPhoenix.Form.remove_nested(form, path)

  @spec reorder(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), [integer()]) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def reorder(form, path, order), do: AshPhoenix.Form.reorder(form, path, order)

  @spec move(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), :up | :down) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def move(form, path, direction), do: AshPhoenix.Form.move(form, path, direction)

  @spec submitted_params(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def submitted_params(form), do: AshPhoenix.Form.params(form)

  @spec hidden_inputs(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: map()
  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_inputs(form, path)
    |> Enum.into(%{})
    |> Enum.reject(fn {key, _} -> key == "_touched" end)
    |> Map.new()
  end

  @spec error_map(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def error_map(form) do
    form
    |> AshPhoenix.Form.errors(all: true)
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn error, acc ->
      path = error.path
      path_str = if path == [], do: @root_name, else: "#{@root_name}[#{Enum.join(path, "][")}]"

      field = to_string(error.field)
      message = error.message

      Map.update(acc, path_str, [[field, message]], fn errors ->
        Enum.sort(errors ++ [[field, message]])
      end)
    end)
  end

  @spec raw_error_list(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: [
          {atom(), String.t(), keyword()}
        ]
  def raw_error_list(form, path) do
    path_segments = parse_path(path)
    target_form = find_form(form, path_segments)
    AshPhoenix.Form.errors(target_form) |> Enum.sort_by(fn e -> {e.field, e.message} end)
  end

  @spec serialize(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def serialize(form) do
    %{
      "name" => form.name,
      "id" => form.id,
      "type" => form.type,
      "resource" => inspect(form.resource),
      "valid" => AshPhoenix.Form.valid?(form),
      "hidden" => hidden_inputs(form, form.name),
      "values" => serialize_values(form),
      "errors" =>
        AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form)
        |> Enum.map(fn e -> [to_string(e.field), e.message] end)
        |> Enum.sort(),
      "nested" => serialize_nested(form)
    }
  end

  @spec save(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), map() | nil) ::
          {:ok, Order.t()} | {:error, AshPhoenix.Form.t()}
  def save(form, params \\ nil) do
    form
    |> AshPhoenix.Form.submit(params: params)
    |> case do
      {:ok, result} ->
        loaded =
          Ash.load!(result, [
            :customer,
            [line_items: :modifiers]
          ])

        sorted =
          %{loaded | line_items: Enum.sort_by(loaded.line_items, & &1.position)}
          |> Map.update!(:line_items, fn items ->
            Enum.map(items, fn item ->
              %{item | modifiers: Enum.sort_by(item.modifiers, & &1.position)}
            end)
          end)

        {:ok, sorted}

      {:error, form} ->
        {:error, form}
    end
  end

  # Helpers

  defp parse_path(path) do
    case Regex.run(~r/^\[(.*)\]$/, path) do
      [_, rest] ->
        String.split(rest, "[") |> Enum.map(&String.replace(&1, "]", ""))

      nil ->
        String.replace_prefix(path, "#{@root_name}[", "")
        |> String.replace_suffix("]", "")
        |> String.split("][")
        |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))
    end
  end

  defp find_form(form, []), do: form

  defp find_form(form, [h | t]) do
    case Enum.find(form.forms, fn f -> f.name == h end) do
      nil -> find_form(form, t)
      found -> find_form(found, t)
    end
  end

  defp serialize_values(form) do
    form.params
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_k, v} -> is_map(v) end)
    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn {k, v} -> {k, to_string(v)} end)
  end

  defp serialize_nested(form) do
    if form.forms == [] do
      nil
    else
      Enum.into(form.forms, %{}, fn f ->
        if String.match?(f.name, ~r/^\d+$/) do
          # Actually this is a list of forms, we need to group by parent key
          # But AshPhoenix.Form.forms structure is flat, children are nested.
          # Actually f is the child form, its name is index.
          # We need to find the parent form and group by that.
          # This is complex. Let's rely on Phoenix naming for now.
          {f.name, serialize(f)}
        else
          {f.name, serialize(f)}
        end
      end)
    end
  end
end

defmodule Catering.Forms do
  @moduledoc """
  Facade that the LiveView layer uses to build, mutate, inspect and submit the
  nested catering order form.
  """

  alias Catering.Orders.Order

  @root_name "order"

  @spec new_order_form() :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def new_order_form do
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_create(Order, :place, name: @root_name)
  end

  @spec edit_order_form(String.t() | Ash.UUID.t()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def edit_order_form(order_id) when is_binary(order_id) do
    order =
      Ash.get!(Order, order_id, load: [
        :customer,
        [line_items: :modifiers]
      ])

    AshPhoenix.Form.for_update(order, :revise, name: @root_name, forms: [
      customer: [],
      delivery_windows: [],
      fulfillment: [],
      line_items: [forms: [:modifiers], opts: [sort: :position]]
    ])
  end

  @spec to_phoenix_form(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: Phoenix.HTML.Form.t()
  def to_phoenix_form(form), do: Phoenix.Component.to_form(form)

  @spec change(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), map(), keyword()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def change(form, params, opts \\ []), do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)

  @spec add_nested(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), keyword()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_form(form, path, opts)
  end

  @spec remove_nested(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def remove_nested(form, path), do: AshPhoenix.Form.remove_form(form, path)

  @spec reorder(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), [integer()]) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def reorder(form, path, order) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.update_forms_at_path(form, path, fn forms ->
      Enum.map(order, &Enum.at(forms, &1))
    end)
  end

  @spec move(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), :up | :down) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def move(form, path, direction) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.update_forms_at_path(form, path, fn forms ->
      move_forms(forms, direction)
    end)
  end

  @spec submitted_params(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def submitted_params(form), do: AshPhoenix.Form.params(form)

  @spec hidden_inputs(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: map()
  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    target = AshPhoenix.Form.get_form(form, path)

    AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_fields(target)
    |> Enum.into(%{})
    |> Enum.reject(fn {key, _} -> key == "_touched" end)
    |> Map.new()
  end

  @spec error_map(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def error_map(form) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form, all: true)
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn error, acc ->
      path = error.path
      path_str = if path == [], do: @root_name, else: "#{@root_name}[#{Enum.join(path, "][")}]"

      field = to_string(error.field)
      message = error.message

      Map.update(acc, path_str, [[field, message]], fn errors ->
        Enum.sort(errors ++ [[field, message]])
      end)
    end)
  end

  @spec raw_error_list(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: [
          {atom(), String.t(), keyword()}
        ]
  def raw_error_list(form, path) do
    target = AshPhoenix.Form.get_form(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.raw_errors(target) |> Enum.sort_by(fn e -> {e.field, e.message} end)
  end

  @spec serialize(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def serialize(form) do
    %{
      "name" => form.name,
      "id" => form.id,
      "type" => form.type,
      "resource" => inspect(form.resource),
      "valid" => form.valid?,
      "hidden" => hidden_inputs(form, form.name),
      "values" => serialize_values(form),
      "errors" =>
        AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form)
        |> Enum.map(fn e -> [to_string(e.field), e.message] end)
        |> Enum.sort(),
      "nested" => serialize_nested(form)
    }
  end

  @spec save(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), map() | nil) ::
          {:ok, Order.t()} | {:error, AshPhoenix.Form.t()}
  def save(form, params \\ nil) do
    form
    |> AshPhoenix.Form.submit(params: params)
    |> case do
      {:ok, result} ->
        loaded =
          Ash.load!(result, [
            :customer,
            [line_items: :modifiers]
          ])

        sorted =
          %{loaded | line_items: Enum.sort_by(loaded.line_items, & &1.position)}
          |> Map.update!(:line_items, fn items ->
            Enum.map(items, fn item ->
              %{item | modifiers: Enum.sort_by(item.modifiers, & &1.position)}
            end)
          end)

        {:ok, sorted}

      {:error, form} ->
        {:error, form}
    end
  end

  # Helpers

  defp move_forms(forms, :up) do
    {left, right} = Enum.split(forms, 1)
    right ++ left
  end

  defp move_forms(forms, :down) do
    {left, right} = Enum.split(forms, -1)
    right ++ left
  end

  defp serialize_values(form) do
    form.params
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_k, v} -> is_map(v) end)
    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn {k, v} -> {k, to_string(v)} end)
  end

  defp serialize_nested(form) do
    if form.forms == %{} do
      nil
    else
      Enum.into(form.forms, %{}, fn {key, value} ->
        value =
          if is_list(value) do
            Enum.map(value, &serialize/1)
          else
            serialize(value)
          end

        {to_string(key), value}
      end)
    end
  end
end

defmodule Catering.Forms do
  @moduledoc """
  Facade that the LiveView layer uses to build, mutate, inspect and submit the
  nested catering order form.
  """

  alias Catering.Orders.Order

  @root_name "order"

  @spec new_order_form() :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def new_order_form do
    AshPhoenix.Form.for_create(Order, :place, name: @root_name)
  end

  @spec edit_order_form(String.t() | Ash.UUID.t()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def edit_order_form(order_id) when is_binary(order_id) do
    order =
      Ash.get!(Order, order_id, load: [
        :customer,
        [line_items: :modifiers]
      ])

    AshPhoenix.Form.for_update(order, :revise, name: @root_name, forms: [
      customer: [],
      delivery_windows: [],
      fulfillment: [],
      line_items: [forms: [:modifiers], opts: [sort: :position]]
    ])
  end

  @spec to_phoenix_form(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: Phoenix.HTML.Form.t()
  def to_phoenix_form(form), do: Phoenix.Component.to_form(form)

  @spec change(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), map(), keyword()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def change(form, params, opts \\ []), do: AshPhoenix.Form.validate(form, params, opts)

  @spec add_nested(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), keyword()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def add_nested(form, path, opts \\ []) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.add_form(form, path, opts)
  end

  @spec remove_nested(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def remove_nested(form, path), do: AshPhoenix.Form.remove_form(form, path)

  @spec reorder(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), [integer()]) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def reorder(form, path, order) do
    pairs = parse_path(form.name, path)
    parent_keys = Enum.slice(pairs, 0..-2//1)
    {last_k, _last_i} = List.last(pairs)
    k = String.to_existing_atom(last_k)

    parent = get_form(form, parent_keys)
    forms = parent.forms[k]
    new_forms = Enum.map(order, &Enum.at(forms, &1))

    new_parent = update_in(parent.forms[k], fn _ ->
      Enum.with_index(new_forms, fn f, i ->
        {pos, _len} = List.last(:binary.matches(f.name, "["))
        prefix = String.slice(f.name, 0..(pos - 1))
        %{f | name: "#{prefix}[#{i}]", changed?: true}
      end)
    end)

    put_form(form, parent_keys, new_parent)
  end

  @spec move(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t(), :up | :down) :: AshPhoenix.Form.t()
  def move(form, path, direction) do
    pairs = parse_path(form.name, path)
    {last_k, last_i} = List.last(pairs)
    k = String.to_existing_atom(last_k)
    parent = get_form(form, Enum.slice(pairs, 0..-2//1))
    idx = String.to_integer(last_i)
    len = length(parent.forms[k])

    new_i = if direction == :up, do: max(0, idx - 1), else: min(len - 1, idx + 1)

    if new_i == idx do
      form
    else
      order =
        0..(len - 1)
        |> Enum.sort_by(fn i ->
          cond do
            i == idx -> new_i
            i == new_i -> idx
            true -> i
          end
        end)

      reorder(form, path, order)
    end
  end

  @spec submitted_params(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def submitted_params(form), do: AshPhoenix.Form.params(form)

  @spec hidden_inputs(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: map()
  def hidden_inputs(form, path) do
    target = AshPhoenix.Form.get_form(form, path)

    AshPhoenix.Form.hidden_fields(target)
    |> Enum.into(%{})
    |> Enum.reject(fn {key, _} -> key == "_touched" end)
    |> Map.new()
  end

  @spec error_map(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def error_map(form) do
    AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form, all: true)
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn error, acc ->
      path = error.path
      path_str = if path == [], do: form.name, else: "#{form.name}[#{Enum.join(path, "][")}]"

      field = to_string(error.field)
      message = error.message

      Map.update(acc, path_str, [[field, message]], fn errors ->
        Enum.sort(errors ++ [[field, message]])
      end)
    end)
  end

  @spec raw_error_list(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), String.t()) :: [
          {atom(), String.t(), keyword()}
        ]
  def raw_error_list(form, path) do
    target = AshPhoenix.Form.get_form(form, path)
    AshPhoenix.Form.raw_errors(target) |> Enum.sort_by(fn e -> {e.field, e.message} end)
  end

  @spec serialize(AshPhoenix.Form.t()) :: map()
  def serialize(form) do
    %{
      "name" => form.name,
      "id" => form.id,
      "type" => form.type,
      "resource" => inspect(form.resource),
      "valid" => form.valid?,
      "hidden" => hidden_inputs(form, form.name),
      "values" => serialize_values(form),
      "errors" =>
        AshPhoenix.Form.errors(form)
        |> Enum.map(fn e -> [to_string(e.field), e.message] end)
        |> Enum.sort(),
      "nested" => serialize_nested(form)
    }
  end

  @spec save(AshPhoenix.Form.t(), map() | nil) ::
          {:ok, Order.t()} | {:error, AshPhoenix.Form.t()}
  def save(form, params \\ nil) do
    form
    |> AshPhoenix.Form.submit(params: params)
    |> case do
      {:ok, result} ->
        loaded =
          Ash.load!(result, [
            :customer,
            [line_items: :modifiers]
          ])

        sorted =
          %{loaded | line_items: Enum.sort_by(loaded.line_items, & &1.position)}
          |> Map.update!(:line_items, fn items ->
            Enum.map(items, fn item ->
              %{item | modifiers: Enum.sort_by(item.modifiers, & &1.position)}
            end)
          end)

        {:ok, sorted}

      {:error, form} ->
        {:error, form}
    end
  end

  # Helpers

  defp parse_path(root, name) do
    parts =
      String.replace_prefix(name, root, "")
      |> String.trim("[")
      |> String.trim("]")
      |> String.split("][")
      |> Enum.reject(&(&1 == ""))

    Enum.chunk_every(parts, 2) |> Enum.map(&List.to_tuple/1)
  end

  defp get_form(form, []), do: form

  defp get_form(form, [{k, i} | rest]) do
    child = form.forms[String.to_existing_atom(k)]
    get_form(Enum.at(child, String.to_integer(i)), rest)
  end

  defp put_form(_form, [], new), do: new

  defp put_form(form, parent_keys, new) do
    path =
      Enum.flat_map(parent_keys, fn {k, i} ->
        [Access.key(:forms), Access.key(String.to_existing_atom(k)), Access.at(String.to_integer(i))]
      end)

    update_in(form, path, fn _ -> new end)
  end

  defp serialize_values(form) do
    form.params
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_k, v} -> is_map(v) end)
    |> Enum.into(%{}, fn {k, v} -> {k, to_string(v)} end)
  end

  defp serialize_nested(form) do
    if form.forms == %{} do
      nil
    else
      Enum.into(form.forms, %{}, fn {key, value} ->
        value =
          if is_list(value) do
            Enum.map(value, &serialize/1)
          else
            serialize(value)
          end

        {to_string(key), value}
      end)
    end
  end
end
